column_lineage.transformation: CASE WHEN c.claim_age_days <= 30 THEN '0-30' WHEN c.claim_age_days <= 90 THEN '31-90' WHEN c.claim_age_days <= 180 THEN '91-180' ELSE '180+' END

summary: This job aggregates open claim counts and total reserve amounts grouped by product code and claim age bands into rpt.open_reserves for the Reserving committee.
risk_notes: String Comparison: T-SQL filter `c.status = 'OPEN'` is case-insensitive under default SQL Server collations (matching 'Open' or 'open'), whereas PySpark filter comparisons are strictly case-sensitive.

NULL Handling in Age Bands: If `c.claim_age_days` is NULL, T-SQL assigns the row to the `ELSE '180+'` band; PySpark `when()` logic will behave similarly but should explicitly handle NULLs to avoid miscategorization.

Decimal Precision on SUM: T-SQL `SUM(c.reserve_amount)` preserves fixed-point `DECIMAL` precision and scale, whereas PySpark may alter decimal scale/precision rules or promote to `DoubleType` if the source Delta/Parquet schema is not strictly typed.
